repairs.title: G1 scalar estimator orientation
repairs.defect: log_g = clip(-mean(observed - training_baseline), *support) was anti-monotone against the frozen M0 generator.
repairs.analytic_derivation: generator.py::_response_matrix: u = (E/45)/g, mu = mu_inf + (1-mu_inf)*exp(-(u**phi_p)), mu_inf in (0.15,0.30) always < 1, phi_p in (1.20,1.70) always > 0. For fixed E>0: g increasing -> u decreasing -> u**phi_p decreasing -> exp(-(.)) increasing -> mu increasing. mu is strictly increasing in g for every valid (mu_inf, phi_p) draw.
repairs.minimum_correction: Removed the sign flip: log_g = clip(residual, *support). No other line changed.
unchanged: G1 thresholds (0.80 Spearman, 0.70 Wilson lower, MURU_PAPER_BENCHMARK_METRICS.md / analysis.py untouched)
repairs.tests_added: tests/test_paper_benchmark_protocol.py: 6 new tests (hand-built canaries, 6 true-g values spanning 0.75-2.50, reproducing the M0 law directly with fixed mu_inf/phi_p; no case_id/registry/generate_case/partition). Covers positive monotonicity, exact orientation, degenerate-case (log_g==0 when compound == training center), boundary-clip direction, and FM-06 fold-locality across the full canary sweep.
repairs.adversarial_verification: Sign temporarily re-inverted in a throwaway copy; 4 of the 6 new tests failed as expected (test_g1_estimate_is_positive_monotonic_in_true_g, test_g1_estimate_orientation_matches_frozen_generator, test_g1_estimate_sign_is_not_inverted, test_g1_boundary_clip_direction_is_correct). Degenerate-case and fold-locality tests correctly stayed green either way (sign-invariant by construction).

Unmapped raw symbols (PySR-default x0/x1/...) silently reported empty support instead of SUPPORT_UNRESOLVED.
repair: Bound square=x**2, cube=x**3, inv=1/x in _safe_parse's locals, reproduced verbatim from the sibling frozen module src/muru/discovery/grammar.py::_SYMPY_LOCALS.

Aliased 'x{i}' to the SAME Symbol object as GRAMMAR_PRIMITIVES[i], the covariate order already frozen in rc3_calibration_worlds.py::CALIBRATION_COVARIATE_ORDER and rc3_ceiling.py::CEILING_COVARIATE_ORDER.

repairs.title: G2 truth support producer
repairs.defect: classify_support(discovered_support, truth_support) always required a truth_support operand; nothing in the repository produced one (rc3_acceptance.py explicitly declines to read it; rc3_record.py's CaseExecutionRecord.truth_support was a schema slot only).
repairs.unique_derivation: generator.py::_law's active_variables (already written for every TruthRecord) is the single source of truth. Four of five G2-applicable law shapes already use exact GRAMMAR_PRIMITIVES names ('mass', 'descriptor'). The fifth (mass_interaction, family F10) uses block labels 'interaction_left'/'interaction_right'; generator.py's single interaction branch returns, in the same call, both the law string '...*descriptor*descriptor2...' and active_variables=['mass','interaction_left','interaction_right'] -- the block labels are mechanically forced 1:1, in the order they already appear, onto descriptor/descriptor2. Only one branch in _law ever produces these labels (verified: single grep hit), so there is no second, conflicting reading.
repairs.repair: Added truth_support_for_case(truth: TruthRecord) -> frozenset[str]. Gated on TruthRecord.symbolic_truth_kind == 'defined' (per-variant frozen registry metadata already carried onto every generated TruthRecord by generator.py -- read directly off the record rather than re-resolved via registry.resolve_case_id, which would have pulled the 'registry' module into g2_contract.py's A3.4 sealed-boundary import closure and failed scripts/pb_35_a3_4_integrity.py's static scan). Raises ValueError for non-G2-applicable families, unrecognized mathematical_family, or an unmapped active_variable label, rather than guessing.
unchanged: no partition-dependent logic (structurally proven: 'partition' not in truth_support_for_case.__code__.co_names)
repairs.tests_added: tests/test_r4_g2_truth_support.py (new, 18 tests): hand-built block-label mapping unit tests; exhaustive parametrized coverage of all 12 G2-applicable families (F01-F05, F08-F12, F17, F18) via generate_case on the development partition only, proving support is produced, deterministic, matches a hand-derived expected-support table per family (independent cross-check, not circular), and that every non-applicable family raises rather than guessing; a structural (bytecode-level) proof of no partition-dependent logic; and integration with the untouched classify_support.
